en: "Now, get those requests done, and be quick about it!{w}I, Walmitt, don't lift a finger out of pity, you know!?"{w}
"Three requests completed. Good, that'll do.{w}Here it is: 'The Saimar Merchant's Companion'! Take it!"{w}
note: Reuses the slice_011 (row 3171) title 'The Saimar Merchant's Companion'; set off with single quotes as in row 5318.

en:
[Key Item]
You obtained 'The Saimar Merchant's Companion'.{w}
note: Title kept in single quotes because it starts with 'The'.

en: "You lot show real promise."{w}{p}"I love people who can get the job done. From now on, drop by and see me whenever you're in the area."{w}{p}"Let's scratch each other's backs, shall we?{w}Hahaha!!"{w}
note: Walmitt switches from kimi-tachi to omae-tachi here: 'you lot'.

en: "Hey there! Keeping well, are you!!"{w}
"Oh?{w}You're telling me you can resolve that request?"{w}
Resolve the request?
"What, just wasting my time?{w}Honestly, you adventurers have far too much time on your hands. If you've no intention of working, go home."{w}
note: hiyakashi (browsing with no intent to buy) rendered 'just wasting my time'.

en: "...Mm. I, Walmitt, have duly confirmed that the request is complete."{w}
"I welcome capable people, whatever their background.{w}It's modest, but this is a reward for living up to my trust."{w}
You received 1500 GP.{w}
"By all means, do drop by again."{w}

"Huh? You call this completing the request?{w}Don't make me laugh, you haven't done a thing.{w}Honestly, this is why adventurers are..."{w}{p}"Listen. In my line of business, trust comes first. People who do sloppy work like you won't get so much as 1 GP from me. Come back when you've done it properly."{w}
"Now, now, you people.{w}Hasn't that request already been resolved?"{w}
Tarmeet

"Welcome, adventurers!{w}It's time once again for Tarmeet the Alchemy Lover!!"{w}{p}"You came all the way to Gandra Mine because you want to learn alchemy too, right? These glasses see through everything!!"{w}
note: Renkin daisuki Tarmeet no jikan: styled like a show segment, 'It's time once again for Tarmeet the Alchemy Lover'. Bokensha is unmarked for number; party addressed as kimi-tachi, so 'adventurers'.

en: Ask about alchemy?
"Why!?{w}I'm offering to teach you, you know!?{w}W-wait! Hey, youuu!!"{w}
"Certainly, certainly!!{w}I'll teach you, I'll tell you all about it! Don't hold back, ask away! C'mooon!!"{w}
"If there's anything about alchemy items you don't understand, come see me anytime!"{w}
"Hiiic~..."{w}
note: Drunken 'ui~' rendered as a hiccup; '~' kept from the source long-vowel mark.

en: Gary

"Me, I'm... the great Gary, I am...{w}I work here in Gandra, y'know.{w}...Hey, you got any catnip water?"{w}{p}"Me, see? In Gandra, I go p-pushin' the b-bellowsh... like... this...{w}Ain't there any catnip waaater!? ...Huh?"{w}{p}"So like I said, me..."{w}
note: Slurred 'fuhigo' (fuigo, bellows) kept slurred. Catnip water per glossary note. Last page trails off by design.
Gary fighting back vomit; sounds approximated.

en: "Hah, hah... I-I'm fine... Hiiic~..."{w}
Gary is asleep...{w}As he sleeps, he keeps yanking out the hairs on the slovenly belly sticking out of his clothes.{w}
note: Gary is male per glossary, so 'he'.

en: Tris
"Gary. I would like you to wake up.{w}If you sleep there, the delivery wagon cannot get through."{w}
note: Tris's polite ~no desu voice: no contractions throughout. Gary-san / Tarmeet-san rendered as the bare name (Tarmeet's gender is unknown, so no Mr./Ms. for either, for consistency).

en: "Garyyy?{w}If you keep sleeping like that, I will run you over with the wagon, you know? Honestly."{w}{p}"You people over there. I would like you to help me move Gary out of the way a little."{w}
note: hiichau: Tris is the one who would run Gary over (wagon de), so 'I will run you over'.

en: You tried to lift Gary up.{w}
"Urp!?"{w}
"Eek!?"{w}
"...Gary, you just escaped with your life.{w}If it ever comes to that, I will not show any mercy, you know!?{w}Honestly, really... I am very cross."{w}
note: punpun desu (cute anger) rendered 'I am very cross'. [acc] moshimo no toki wa yousha shimasen is a non-past warning about next time, not a past counterfactual.

en: Tris left.{w}
"Ah... aaah...{w}Y-y-you lot...{w}Got a sec...?"{w}
For once, a sober Gary speaks to you.{w}{p}Gary is holding a cute umbrella that doesn't suit his looks at all.{w}
note: matomo na Gary = for once lucid/sober.

en: "L-look at this... It's a cute umbrella, ain't it?{w}...No, that ain't what I'm getting at."{w}{p}"You might not believe me, but this umbrella...{w}I brought it back out of a dream!!"{w}{p}"I was dozing off, and I wandered into some weird world.{w}I was roaming around, and I ended up in this strange room."{w}{p}"Next thing I know, I woke up, but for some reason, in my hand... was the umbrella I saw in that room in the dream!"{w}{p}"Ever since, whenever I sleep, someone with a terrifying voice comes chasing after me, going 'Give back the umbrella, give back the umbrella.'"{w}{p}"When I'm sprawled out on some floor, I'm fine. But if I sleep somewhere with a proper pillow... Eeeeek!!"{w}
note: Item left generic ('cute umbrella'); the item name itself is not in this slice.

en: "I'm too scared to sleep anymore!{w}Please, take this umbrella off my hands!!"{w}
"I-I gave it to ya, all right? I gave it to ya, ya hear!?"{w}
"Aaagh! Yoooou!!"{w}
note: Trigger of this outburst not visible in the slice (probably the party handing the umbrella back or refusing); kept as a bare 'You!!' without guessing.

en: "W-well?{w}You can sleep somewhere with a pillow, and nothing happens?"{w}

"So you gave it back! Well, ain't that great..."{w}{p}"...is what I'd like to say, but!!"{w}{p}"Look at thiiis!
I brought it back agaaain!{w}What is WRONG with meeee!!"{w}
note: ore wa, ore tte yatsu wa: self-reproach, 'What is WRONG with me'. Kept the source line break between the two exclamations.

en: ...Perhaps it's a talent of sorts.{w}
"I'm too scared to sleep anymore!{w}Please, take this umbrella off my hands again!!"{w}

"Okay, line up, line up. I would like you to line up.{w}No cutting in line."{w}{p}"...Oh, you people are not from Gandra?"{w}{p}"I am sorry, this food is made for the miners, so I cannot share it with you."{w}
note: zuru wa dame (no cheating) in a meal queue: 'No cutting in line'; row 5483 confirms the party broke a rule.

en: "I am sorry, I did not introduce myself. I am Tris.{w}I am a serving magic puppet that Tarmeet built."{w}
note: magic puppet per glossary.

en: "The one who made me, Tarmeet, is this weirdo right here."{w}
"Tris, there's no call to introduce me as a weirdo!?"{w}
note: Tarmeet's complaint phrased with 'someone/them' to avoid gendering the speaker in the third person. [acc] Tarmeet objects to being introduced; first person 'me' needs no gendered pronoun, and 'them' could be misread as the party.

en: "Tarmeet is the one who built me so I cannot lie."{w}{p}"Tarmeet's speech, thinking and lifestyle differ from those of the average Gandra resident, so Tarmeet meets the requirements of a weirdo."{w}
"Tch... And another thing."{w}
"Yes."{w}
note: hai desu: rendered 'Yes.' so Tarmeet's later "Don't 'Yes' me!" (5440, 5493) lands; the line also serves as a reply to being called.

en: "What is this!!{w}I told you I hate bitter melon, didn't I?"{w}
note: nigauri = bitter melon (new term).

en: "Don't 'Yes' me! If you know, why do you put it in?"{w}{p}"I can't stand it even showing up in the corner of these glasses! I won't eat this stuff!"{w}
"Tarmeet's likes and dislikes have nothing to do with the food the body needs."{w}
"They do.{w}Eating it puts me in a bad mood.{w}It's bad for my mental health."{w}
"That is not a reason.{w}I judge that they have nothing to do with it."{w}
"They do so."{w}
note: kankei aru no: childish insistence.

en: "They do not."{w}
"...Come here, you! I'll remodel you!!"{w}
"Tarmeet said unauthorized modifications are not allowed."{w}
"This is no unauthorized modification! It's the voice of your creator!{w}I'll modify you so you can't even recognize bitter melon!!"{w}
"No, that is not allowed. If you do something cruel to me without my consent, I will have to defend myself."{w}
"Shut up, get over here!"{w}
"Oh, well. Tris puuunch."{w}
"Gwah!"{w}
"Tris kiiick, kiiick."{w}
"Gohh, gehhh!?"{w}
Tris sent Tarmeet flying!{w}

"'Tough luck!
I'm a magic puppet built by the great Tarmeet, the greatest genius alchemist in Gandra's history!'"{w}{p}"'Like I'd ever lose to a pea-brain like you! Run on home, you villain!'{w}
note: Tris recites the victory line Tarmeet registered, in its rough voice (ore, temee). The source never closes the outer quote on page 2; closed it in English. [acc] Outer quote left open again as in the source: row 5473 redraws this page with {0E}..{0F} and closes it; the redrawn text now matches exactly.

en: {0E}"'Like I'd ever lose to a pea-brain like you! Run on home, you villain!'{0F}...is how it goes~"{w}
note: Tris tacks a polite 'desu~' onto the crude line; rendered '...is how it goes~'. {0E}/{0F} kept in place.

en: "Th-that victory line I registered myself... I hate it..."{w}
"Tarmeet has confessed to leaving the bitter melon uneaten, so next time there will be extra bitter melon."{w}
"I-I should've built you to be more flexible... Dammit..."{w}
note: [acc] Subject I restored (Tarmeet built Tris).

en: "Tarmeet wanted me to be autonomous."{w}{p}"That is why even Tarmeet cannot give me orders that I must completely obey."{w}
"Still, why do you people break the rules?{w}What do you gain from it?"{w}{p}"I do not understand it at all."{w}

"I am in trouble.{w}My cooking utensils broke."{w}{p}"I tried to make a new dish for everyone, but..."{w}{p}"The old frying pan and ladle could not stand up to the cooking and were ruined."{w}{p}"Around here, it is hard to find utensils sturdier than the ones from Gandra."{w}{p}"If there are any, they would be the goods the Cyclops of the Scorching Castle make."{w}{p}"I am sorry to ask you all, but could you go to the Scorching Castle and buy a frying pan and ladle for me?"{w}{p}"I cannot leave my post.{w}Please, I am counting on you."{w}
note: 'Cyclops' (number unmarked in Japanese) kept as an unmarked plural-capable noun. Scorching Castle per glossary. 'minasan no tame' = for everyone (diners), not narrowed to the party.

en: "Ah. You people.{w}Did you find a frying pan and ladle?{w}It seems not yet. That is too bad."{w}
"TRIIIIIS!!"{w}
"Don't you 'Yes' meeee!{w}What's today's grub!"{w}{p}"Bitter melon bread, bitter melon soup, bitter melon salad and bitter melon meuniere!!{w}Are you trying to kill me!?"{w}
note: Answers Tris's 'Yes.' (row 5434 text reused at a later occurrence).
